identity.original_title: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite

hooks.text: 每局沿不同动物进化路线，创造外形与机制都独一无二的生物
hooks.excerpt: Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从125种能力中拼接腿、钳、翅膀、毛皮与触手，造出荒诞嵌合体
hooks.excerpt: Over 125 abilities combine to create a plethora of different builds and playstyles: Become a wily trickster, a ferocious predator, a gregarious leader, a nimble nomad, or take on any number of other survival strategies. Legs! Claws! Pincers! Wings! More Legs! Fur! Tail! Scales! Tentacles! I SAID MORE LEGS!!! Build your formidable, visually awkward chimera or get Darwin'd in the process.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 混合遗传起始角色，在开局前就生成不同的进化底盘
hooks.excerpt: Genetics (starting Characters), which can be combined to create endless starting character combinations
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏缺少存档，退出会丢失本局进度。

excerpts.excerpt: 这游戏没有存档功能的救赎感，退出去就算你这一把白玩了
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高压力等级只剩下困难感。

excerpts.excerpt: until high pressure levels - then it's just hard
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高压力玩法变成耗时碰运气的重复刷取。

excerpts.excerpt: 压力5以上的游玩全是些堆砌时间碰运气的重复刷取工作
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 主动技能种类反复且不足。

excerpts.excerpt: 主动技能翻来覆去就那几个
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 各局内容不足且体验趋同。

excerpts.excerpt: There's not enough to do for all the runs to end up feeling basically the same
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 体验多个流派后很快变得无聊。

excerpts.excerpt: after a few runs with each different playstyle, it gets pretty boring
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 非常非常难见到加速度的天赋
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 根本就没办法完成完整的构筑
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 除物理叠甲外的其他流派难以获得爽感。

excerpts.excerpt: 其他流派:叠毒，群攻，远程的也好，这些都爽不起来
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
